hooks.name: Secret scan on save
hooks.description: Checks tracked and untracked non-ignored text files for selected credential patterns without printing values. Requires Git and Python 3.

action.command:
python3 - <<'PY_SCAN'
import pathlib
import re
import subprocess
import sys

try:
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "ls-files", "-z", "--cached", "--others", "--exclude-standard"],
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, check=True,
    )
except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError):
    print("ERROR: Could not list project files for secret scanning.", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)

pattern = re.compile(
    rb"(?:AKIA|ASIA)[0-9A-Z]{16}|"
    rb"gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}|github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}|"
    rb"sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}|-----BEGIN (?:[A-Z0-9]+ )*PRIVATE KEY-----"
)
found = False
failed = False
scanned = 0
skipped = 0
for raw in sorted(set(result.stdout.split(b"\0")) - {b""}):
    path = pathlib.Path(raw.decode(sys.getfilesystemencoding(), "surrogateescape"))
    try:
        if path.is_symlink():
            skipped += 1
            continue
        if not path.exists():
            # Tracked deletions are not files to scan.
            continue
        if not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size > 2 * 1024 * 1024:
            skipped += 1
            continue
        data = path.read_bytes()
    except OSError:
        print(f"ERROR: Could not scan {str(path)!r}.", file=sys.stderr)
        failed = True
        continue
    if b"\0" in data:
        skipped += 1
        continue
    scanned += 1
    is_env = path.name == ".env" or (
        path.name.startswith(".env.") and not path.name.endswith((".example", ".sample", ".template"))
    )
    if is_env:
        print(f"REVIEW: Environment file included by Git: {str(path)!r}.", file=sys.stderr)
        found = True
    for line_number, line in enumerate(data.splitlines(), 1):
        if pattern.search(line):
            print(f"REVIEW: Potential credential at {str(path)!r}:{line_number}; value hidden.", file=sys.stderr)
            found = True
if skipped:
    print(f"LIMIT: {skipped} binary, oversized, symlink, or non-file entries were not scanned.")
if failed:
    sys.exit(2)
if found:
    sys.exit(1)
print(f"PASS: No configured secret patterns found in {scanned} scanned text files; ignored files and history excluded.")
PY_SCAN
